primary_population: scheduling; workflow estimates separately labeled secondary
cluster: base_pair_id across worlds, renderings, arms, repetitions, models
model_averaging: equal weight per model after averaging repetitions and worlds within base pair; always report each model separately

primary_contrasts.contrast: mean(exact,paraphrase)-single on consequential pairs minus same on preserving pairs

p_values: not reported in initial analysis; if added, Holm-adjust all six primary tests

denominators.decision_error: all planned completed trajectories, including malformed completed outputs as errors; interrupted transport calls remain visibly incomplete
denominators.invalid_selection: all completed trajectories; separate conditional rate among candidate selections
denominators.pair_correctness: all complete paired cells with both worlds; malformed completed answers count incorrect
denominators.responsiveness: both worlds correctly answered among decision-changing pairs
denominators.stability: both worlds correctly answered among decision-preserving pairs
denominators.summary_coverage: required distinct scoped assertions delivered to managers
denominators.changed_scope_retention: scoped assertions changed in value or applicability between paired worlds, on consequential pairs
denominators.unique_clause_loss: delivered designated unique scoped assertions absent or wrong in summary
denominators.scope_transfer: emitted assertions whose supporting report binds a different scope
denominators.incorrect_merge: emitted assertions citing reports from incompatible scopes
denominators.failure_to_consolidate: extra emitted equivalent scope-value assertions; not hidden internal reasoning
denominators.superseded_adoption: version-control trajectories with explicitly inapplicable old results
denominators.false_adoption: corrupted-report trajectories with resolvable injected false assertion
denominators.calibration: completed final answers with valid full distributions; report valid-distribution fraction
denominators.cost_per_correct: total measured cost including malformed outputs and retries divided by correct decisions

stopping: freeze sample size from validation before held-out inference; no outcome-based early stopping
competence_gate: at least 85% exact accuracy on development flat-single ordinary trajectories, operational failures included; otherwise report task limitation and revise only development protocol
precision: report pilot cluster discordance and SD; prospective half-width 1.96*SD/sqrt(N) is an approximation, not power
mediation: summary-retention associations exploratory; bypass is an intervention, not evidence of faithful hidden reasoning
